protocol.gpu_selection: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0; no other benchmark process should run concurrently
protocol.timing_scope: host X through validation, preparation, sampling, scoring, selection and complete host W/scores/IDs
protocol.first_call_scope: first call per GPU version in a shared process; the earlier route can warm context/library/module caches for the later route; disk caches may also exist; neither guaranteed cold compilation nor an independent process-first call
protocol.cpu_method: NumPy vectorized random keys + GEMM; checked full API
protocol.cuda_method: CUDA repair sampling + actual public AUTO; actual route recorded per job
protocol.comparability: same statistical task and output contract; different samplers and candidate pools even at the same seed
protocol.aggregation: within-seed median, then median of three seed medians; ratio is median of paired seed ratios
protocol.oracle_scope: selected outputs only; complete-pool correctness is tested separately
protocol.order: alternate CPU block and GPU block by case/seed; one fresh child per block
protocol.gpu_version_order: rotate first route by case/seed; mirror successive rounds; one first call, two warmups and five timed calls per route
protocol.gpu_version_imports: canonical current package plus independently imported frozen V0 alias; origins and source bytes verified
protocol.amendment: Release benchmark GPU versions paired within each child to reduce fresh-process confounding; earlier formal panels remain separate evidence
protocol.tuning_rule: CPU8/B2048 frozen before this release batch; GPU B2048; no runtime tuning
